读着读着，你想到另一件事。这时最不需要的，可能就是一个新的工作窗口。: As you read, something reminds you of another task. A new workspace may be the last thing you need.
你只是想把这一句留给那篇文章，把另一段补给正在查问题的 agent。为了接住这两: You want to keep one sentence for an article and pass another to the agent investigating a problem. To hold onto those two thoughts, the tool makes you switch projects, open a materials panel, and organize everything first. The information is still there. You have stopped reading.
这次，文章本身就是阅读现场。Beamhop 只在你指向一段文字时出现；暂存的材料: This time, the article itself is where you try the interaction. Beamhop appears when you select a passage; saved clips stay in the bottom-right corner.
工作可以分岔，界面不必跟着开枝散叶。: Work can branch without multiplying the interface.

点选这段，试着直接交过去。: Select this passage and try sending it directly.
目的地显示的是你认得的工作：「Beamhop · 阅读不中断」。下面那行才是实际: The destination names the work you recognize: “Beamhop · Keep reading.” The line below identifies the session that will actually receive it.
找对一次之后，下一段就少找一次。: Find it once, and the next passage takes less searching.
需要换地方，再点去处；补一句交代，也可以在需要时展开。: Click the destination when you need to change it. Expand the note field when you have something to add.
这个名称可以比会话活得久。接收会话结束时，需要重新核对地址；不能仅凭相似标题自动: The name can outlast a session. When the receiving session ends, its replacement address needs to be checked; a similar title is no reason to redirect a clip automatically. Those connection controls do not need to be visible all the time.
先留着，不等于开始整理。: Saving a clip need not start an organizing session.
再往下读，你看到另一份材料。它可能有用，但现在还不想发。你需要一个地方先留着它。: Further down, you find another passage. It may be useful, but you do not want to send it yet. You need somewhere to keep it for now.
目标会话不可用时，保留材料，并说明尚未送达。不要让用户重新寻找原文。: If the destination session is unavailable, keep the material and say it has not been delivered. Do not make the user find the original again.
点选这段，再点「先留着」。: Select this passage, then choose “Keep for later.”
右下角只多了一个「手边 · 1 段」。没有列表自动展开，没有新建项目，也没有把光: The corner now says “Shelf · 1 clip.” No list opens, no project is created, and no input field takes focus. That one action was enough.
等你主动展开，才看见原文与出处。选几段，附一句交代，一起交过去。暂时用不到的，继: The original text and its source appear when you choose to expand the shelf. Select a few clips, add a note, and send them together. Leave the rest for later. The shelf should be only as large as the task at hand requires.
接住分岔，不必切换整个工作。: Hold onto the thought without switching your whole task.
你继续阅读，却想到一篇还没写完的文章。下面这句，更适合那篇文章的开头。: You keep reading and think of an unfinished article. This sentence would work better at its opening.
先写一次真实的中断，再解释注意力。让读者先认出自己的经历。: Describe a real interruption before explaining attention. Let readers recognize their own experience first.
可以换到「注意力文章」直接送，也可以先留着。: Send it to “Attention article,” or keep it for later.
如果已经知道去处，在选区旁换一次，直接送。右下角原来的材料仍然留着。如果还想再想: If you know where it belongs, change the destination beside the selection and send it. The clips already on the shelf stay there. If you need more time, save this sentence too. A clip intended for a different destination is not automatically selected with the existing batch; choose the clips you want to hand over when you are ready.
想到另一件事，不应该要求你先切换一个“工作模式”。: Thinking of another task should not require switching to a different “work mode.”
工具需要记住未完成的选择和交代，却不必要求你为每个念头建一个 topic、起一个: The tool needs to remember unfinished selections and notes. It need not ask you to create and name a topic for every thought.
试着展开右下角，取消勾选一段，留一句交代，然后收起。继续读完这一节，再打开：选择: Expand the shelf, deselect a clip, add a note, then collapse it. Read the rest of this section and open it again: your selection and note are still there. Collapsing it just gets the interface out of the way.
04 / 复杂关系，按需看见: 04 / See relationships when you need them
让它记住关系，别让你维护关系。: Let the tool remember the relationships.
同一条测试记录，可以帮助产品讨论判断原因，也可以请实现者检查代码。这是两次交接，: The same test observation can help a product discussion assess a cause and ask an implementer to inspect the code. Those are two handoffs, each with its own destination and note. The original text and source stay the same.
AI 也应当遵守这个顺序：在你找去处时，帮助缩短候选；你已经确认之后，尊重这个选: AI should follow the same order: narrow the candidates while you are looking for a destination, then respect your confirmed choice. A passage being relevant to two projects does not mean it should be sent twice automatically.
试着发送一段。这里只记录材料去了哪里，不在这里生成答案。: Try sending a passage. This records where material went; it does not generate answers.
顺手，有时是少出现一点。: Sometimes, being useful means appearing less.
上一版把临时剪板铺成了一个工作区。它能表达更多关系，却也要求人转移注意力。这与: The previous version expanded a temporary shelf into a workspace. It could show more relationships, but it also demanded a shift in attention. That conflicted with the problem Beamhop is meant to solve.
分岔的事情，可以先留在手边。: The other task can wait on the shelf.
本文探索交互原则，不是已上线功能的说明。材料、去处与接收确认均为模拟；页面不读取: This essay explores interaction principles, not shipped features. Material, destinations, and receipt confirmations are simulated. The page does not read your system clipboard or connect to real agents; refreshing resets it. Background delivery, stable session addresses, and receipt confirmation still require support from the receiving tool.
点选示例原文模拟在来源应用里选中文字。浮条会随阅读滚动收起；右下角只保存你主动留: Selecting a sample passage stands in for selecting text in a source app. The popover closes when you scroll; the shelf keeps only clips you deliberately save. A receipt confirms a handoff, not that an agent has executed or completed the work.
《让信息过去，人留在这里》: “Send the information. Stay where you are.”

接下来这句话仍然在原来的位置。你没有进入另一个应用，也没有先把材料放进剪板。交接: The next sentence is still in the same place. You have not entered another app or put the passage on the shelf first. A small confirmation is enough after the handoff.
这一版把选择交还给具体时刻：选中文字，才出现发送浮条；主动暂存，右下角才有入口；: This version leaves each choice to the moment it is needed: selecting text opens the sending popover; saving a clip makes the corner shelf appear; expanding it shows the material. At other times, you are still looking at the article you were reading.
事实逻辑线关心“这个判断依据什么”；处理线关心“谁接手、准备做什么”。这些关系值: The evidence trail asks what supports a judgment. The work trail asks who is taking it on and what they plan to do. These relationships are worth retaining. Open the handoff history when you want to review them; sending a passage need not begin with a relationship diagram.
